title: Network Service Discovery
text: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts and local network infrastructure. Network service discovery can use port scans or other network queries. This reference describes a technique, not proof that any observed flow is malicious.

title: Experimental network destination port fan-out
citation: AI SOC Analyst Copilot local experimental rule
text: Group normalized network_flow records by src_ip and dst_ip over a bounded time window. A high count of distinct dst_port values may be a network service discovery hypothesis. The count threshold is local and requires environment-specific tuning. It is not a validated production detection.

title: ATT&CK mapping caution
citation: AI SOC Analyst Copilot methodology note
text: ATT&CK technique mappings from network-flow telemetry are hypotheses, not confirmed activity. Flow metadata alone generally cannot establish operator intent, process identity, credential use, or a full attack chain. Cite observed evidence separately from reference knowledge.
